name: Spring-charging motor stop contact
summary: Stops charging when the mechanism reaches the specified charged condition.
description: Stops charging when the mechanism reaches the specified charged condition. A stored-energy breaker mechanism has charging, release, indication and supervision functions. Motor supply, stored spring energy and the ability to complete an opening operation are separate drawing concerns.

In a switchgear panel, a charging motor replenishes the mechanism after an operation. Supervisory contacts let the controller report an incomplete charge or repeated charging demand before an operator requests another operation. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Charged-position contact” at the input and “Charging motor stop” at the output. Contact interpretation follows the mechanism diagram.
